Bug_Details:
Arguments to AutoValue constructor are in the wrong order AutoValue constructors are synthesized with their parameters in the same order
as the abstract accessor methods. Calls to the constructor need to match this
ordering.
Bug_Explanation: Arguments to AutoValue constructor are in the wrong order. AutoValue constructors are synthesized with their parameters in the same order as the abstract accessor methods. Calls to the constructor need to match this ordering.
